name: Blackstrap Molasses
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated in small amounts as it contains minimal fermentable carbohydrates, but use sparingly due to high sugar content.
preparationTips: Measure carefully as molasses is very thick and sticky
Warm slightly to make it easier to pour and measure
Store in a cool, dry place to prevent crystallization
Use as a replacement for other liquid sweeteners in baking
nutritionalHighlights: Lower glycemic impact than refined sugar
